Why Use a Browser Aim Trainer for CS2?

Launching CS2 just to warm up means waiting for Steam, loading maps, and dealing with VAC servers. A browser trainer removes all that friction — you can practice aim for 5 minutes during queue, on a break, or from any device. The exercises use 3D geometry that translates directly to in-game flick and tracking motions, building the same muscle memory without the overhead.

FAQ

Can I use my CS2 sensitivity here?

Yes — use our sensitivity converter to calculate your exact CS2 sens and apply it in the trainer for 1:1 muscle memory.

Is this better than CS2 workshop maps?

It's complementary. Workshop maps are great for spray patterns, but our browser trainer loads instantly for quick warm-ups without launching Steam.

Does this work for CS:GO too?

Yes. CS2 and CS:GO share the same sensitivity system, so the exercises transfer directly.
